name: Snapshot
author: Vestra Player
punchline: Save or copy the current frame and capture bursts
description:
Saves, saves as or copies the current frame (with the subtitles shown, or the rendered frame with video effects) as PNG, JPEG or BMP, and captures a burst of frames. The settings are in Options ▸ Video ▸ Snapshot.
Right-click menu: Snapshot ▸.
